body:
Fix owned-descriptor cleanup in materialize._copy_file and export_git._hash_copy. A target close failure previously skipped source close and could replace a preceding read/write/validation error. Both owned descriptors now receive one independent close attempt. A prior operation exception is re-raised with OWNED_FD_CLOSE_FAILED cleanup notes; otherwise the first cleanup failure propagates, so failed cleanup cannot produce PASS. Partial files remain untouched and there is no descriptor-close retry loop or deletion.

The operation exception is captured explicitly inside each copy function. Ambient sys.exception() is deliberately not used: actual caller-except regressions showed that a handled caller exception can otherwise hide a fresh cleanup failure and permit an incorrect successful return. BaseException during operation/cleanup still receives bounded owned-handle cleanup and propagation; no arbitrary resource or borrowed descriptor is touched.

Source adoption must import BOTH modules from this exact commit: export_git now calls materialize._close_owned_fds. Original f6f3418b0aa262863322c81f30cf290ad2fb2c08 remains an immutable ancestor and PR73 remains unchanged. This separate branch does not hot-patch any running f6 snapshot or interrupt Root's export session. No actual installed Git export or physical action was performed by this task.

Exact HEADe5e9d440a5c8c44b4daaecbe6ed518c990481c74 / tree00dd3c02c31ee14fe92ffd4af268dde86e5ba3a2. materialize.py SHA256451ad1f9bb12c779e761f1c0aae88ed6903b4f00762515b0ceeef8fd161f9325; export_git.py SHA2566e7adc557b3cbb51717868346c83ae82f645625bad6ce8385042304e36bd0823. Only those source files and their two owned tests change; package/assembly policies, fixed roots, caps and authority flags are unchanged.

Validation:80 unique focused tests PASS, zero skips, CPython3.12.10 -I -S -B in a fresh clean exact checkout, full primary raw Git bytes/repository inventory unchanged pre/post. Six new regressions cover both functions: target-close failure still attempts source close; original write error identity plus cleanup note survives double failure; handled caller exceptions cannot suppress cleanup failure. Tests retain and finally close only their actually pending inert fixture FDs, preventing injected leaks. Original four-failure RED and caller-context two-failure RED are retained. Root/A8 source review and adoption remain required; fixture tests confer no runtime/native/physical admission.
title: Preserve copy failures while closing both owned descriptors

 from tools.physical_dev import package as integrity
 
 
+def assert_owned_close_failure(testcase,copy_call,*,write_failure=False):
+    """Inject on owned inert descriptors and close any retained test FDs safely."""
+    real_open=os.open;real_close=os.close;opened=[];attempts=[];pending=set()
+    close_error=OSError("inert target close failure");write_error=OSError("inert prior write failure")
+    def open_owned(*args,**kwargs):
+        descriptor=real_open(*args,**kwargs);opened.append(descriptor);pending.add(descriptor);return descriptor
+    def close_owned(descriptor):
+        attempts.append(descriptor)
+        if len(opened)==2 and descriptor==opened[1]:raise close_error
+        real_close(descriptor);pending.discard(descriptor)
+    captured=None
+    try:
+        with patch.object(materialize.os,"open",side_effect=open_owned),patch.object(materialize.os,"close",side_effect=close_owned):
+            try:
+                if write_failure:
+                    with patch.object(materialize.os,"write",side_effect=write_error):copy_call()
+                else:copy_call()
+            except OSError as exc:captured=exc
+    finally:
+        # The injected close never closes its target. This test's own fallback
+        # closes only the still-pending owned descriptors, with no fd retry loop.
+        for descriptor in pending:real_close(descriptor)
+    testcase.assertEqual(len(opened),2)
+    testcase.assertEqual(attempts,[opened[1],opened[0]])
+    testcase.assertIs(captured,write_error if write_failure else close_error)
+    testcase.assertTrue(any("OWNED_FD_CLOSE_FAILED" in note for note in getattr(captured,"__notes__",[])))
+

+def _close_owned_fds(target_fd,source_fd,original):
+    """Attempt each owned close once without masking a prior operation error."""
+    failures=[]
+    for role,descriptor in (("target",target_fd),("source",source_fd)):
+        if descriptor is None:continue
+        try:os.close(descriptor)
+        except BaseException as exc:failures.append((role,exc))
+    if failures:
+        note="OWNED_FD_CLOSE_FAILED: "+",".join(role+":"+type(exc).__name__ for role,exc in failures)+"; partial evidence retained"

+            failure=failures[0][1];failure.add_note(note)
+            raise failure
